name: workflow-skills
description: Claude skills for the everyday work around the code and the writing, grouped by the tool each one works with. First up: GitHub commands that draft your daily standup and triage community issues and pull requests.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Two GitHub commands you run when you need them: draft your daily standup from yesterday's activity, and find the issues and pull requests from people outside your orgs, plus where you've been tagged.
